Dear Saint Oyant,

I forward herewith for your information a
tabulated statement regarding a prisoner named Wang
Sau Ding (王少亭) alias Zoh Wei (蜀偉) together
with a list of the literature seized in an upstairs
room at No.133 S Eu Li (世厚里), Alcock Road.

The accused was arrested at 4.15 p.m. August
31, 1932 and was ordered to be handed over to the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau on October 11, 1932 by
the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court.

Yours sincerely,

X. Enclos: 2
Sent 27/10

Monsieur R. Saint Oyant,
Chief of the Political Section,
French Police Headquarters.

Mr. T C Lea appeared for the Police.
Mr. Tsu Tsung To appeared for the accused.
Mr. Tsu Kyi Vung appeared for the S.P.S.3.

Rep. S.I...S. Moo Shen Sh'eng :- I ask for the extradition
of the accused. Wong Li Kong made the statement. There is another
man named Wong Ming ei who also implicated the accused as being
a communist. We shall hand the accused over to the Honan
Authorities.

Accused :- I do not know Wong Li Kong. I do not know Wong
Ming wei. I do not know how I have been implicated in the state-
ment. One named Tsang Yu Seng used my place for writing his
correspondence but I did not read any of the correspondence. I
have been a cook for 10 years. I came to Shanghai to open a shop.
I met Tsang Yu Seng on board the ship. I do not know if Wong Ming
Wei is the alias of Tsang Yu Seng. Tsang told me that he was an
ex-military officer.

Mr. Lea :- The Police have no objections to the extradition.
Mr. Tsu :- I ask that the decision of this Court be stayed
for two or three days for me to make a protest.
Judge :- Your application is dismissed.

Decision Accused to be handed over together with seized property to the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau .

KUZNETZOFF, PAVEL.
Reg. No. 5/67018, Sheet No. 2

Proceedings. Mr. Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr. Poo Tsung Yeh for the accused.

Mr. Lee:- The Public Safety Bureau requested the Police to
arrest the accused on the 31st of August, they came with a search
warrant and warrant and stated that the accused would be arrested
at 137, Loock Rd. It was the Honan Government that asked for the
accused as he is an important communist in Honan. In the accused
house some books were found also a bill and a report. The accused
was brought before the Court and was ordered to be detained and the
representative of the P.S.B. to bring more evidence in connection
with the case. The representative of the P.S.B. is in Court today
and if they have sufficient evidence to produce, the Police have no
objection for the accused to be handed over.

Representative. of P.S.B. Woo Seu Jing:- We have written to the
Honan Government but we have not yet received any reply, so I ask
for a further remand.

Mr. Poo :- I ask that the accused be released on security as the
representative has brought no evidence and even if they had done,
the accused should be tried in this Court.

Mr. Lee:- There is a little evidence against the accused. A bill
and a report was found on the accused but that is not sufficient proof
of . The Honan Government want the accused, and it would not be
convenient to allow the accused out on security.

Decision. Case still to be remanded pending production of evidence from the
W.H.J. Public Safety Bureau and a ruling will be given afterwards

Accused o g sim ing ( ) age 32. Unemployed.

Charge Application
Application will be made by representative of Shanghai Public Safety Bureau for the handing over of the accused on a charge of being a Communist.

Proceedings Mr. Lor appeared for the S.S.D.C.
Mr. Lor:-At 4pm. the 31-8-32 the representative of the S.S.P. Bureau armed with a search warrant and a warrant of arrest asked for judicial sanction for assistance to search the accused's room and to arrest the accused. Nothing was found on the premises except two books and accounts. The representatives stated that they had received a telegram from Honan stating that the accused was a communist and that they must arrest him. No further evidence but what is before the Court at present has been found. Rep. Bureau ask that the accused be handed over to them for trial, but before that is done, they should produce more evidence.
C. Det. SSI:-I assisted the representatives of the S.S. Bureau to arrest the accused. We searched the house but found nothing but the two books and the accounts.
Accused:-I came to Shanghai a month ago to find a job. I met a man from my province "Honan" named Tsang Yui Sung and he left the books and the accounts in my room. I am not a member of any party.
Rep. Ying King Sung:-We received a telegram from Honan telling us to arrest the accused as he is a communist and that the arrest could be effected at 132 Alcock Rd. These accounts relate to the expenses of the communist party in Honan, so I ask that the accused be handed over to us for trial.
Mr. Lor:-I ask that the books and the accounts be kept on the Court files.

Decision Accused to be detained pending evidence being produced by the S.S. Bureau, after which case to be dealt with.
Two books and accounts to be kept on Court files.

被告 o g sim ing ( ) 年龄 32岁。无业。

指控申请
上海市公安局代表将提出申请，以共产党员罪名移交被告。

诉讼程序 Lor 先生代表上海特区地方法院（S.S.D.C.）出庭。
Lor 先生:- 1932年8月31日下午4时，上海市公安局（S.S.P. Bureau）代表持搜查令和逮捕令，请求司法批准协助搜查被告房间并逮捕被告。除两本书和账目外，现场未发现其他物品。代表们表示，他们收到来自河南的电报，称被告是共产党员，必须逮捕他。除目前呈堂的证据外，未发现其他证据。公安局代表请求将被告移交给他们进行审判，但在此之前，他们应提供更多证据。
刑事侦缉副督察（C. Det. SSI）:- 我协助公安局代表逮捕了被告。我们搜查了房屋，但除了两本书和账目外，一无所获。
被告:- 我一个月前来上海找工作。我遇到了一位来自我省“河南”的名叫 Tsang Yui Sung 的人，他把书和账目留在我的房间里。我不是任何政党的成员。
Ying King Sung 代表:- 我们收到来自河南的电报，告知我们要逮捕被告，因为他是共产党员，并且可以在阿尔科克路（Alcock Rd.）132号实施逮捕。这些账目涉及河南共产党的经费，所以我请求将被告移交给我们要进行审判。
Lor 先生:- 我请求将书籍和账目保留在法院档案中。

决定 被告予以拘留，等待公安局提供证据，之后处理此案。
两本书和账目保留在法院档案中。

H. Kuh / 备注提及代表
SBR 379.

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 1/9/32

Communist Propaganda - one arrest

Acting on the authority of warrants issued by the
Shanghai Special District Court at the instance of the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau, the Municipal Police at 4.15 p.m. on Aug 31
raided an upstairs front room of Chinese dwelling No. 137
S Eu L; (世厚里), Alcock Road, and arrested one named Tang
Sau Ding (唐少亭), alias Zoh Wei (蜀偉). A small quantity
of pro-communist literature was found on the premises.

The accused will appear before court on Sept 1,
when an application for his extradition will be made by the
Chinese Authorities.

(One form to be used for each person arrested) 31st August 19 32. | Name, age, occupation and address of person arrested. | Wong Sian Ding (王少亭) alias Zoh Wei (周瑋), 32, Szechmen, M/unemployed, 130 | | :--- | :--- | | Arrested by | D.P.Ss Pitts & Fawke and C.D.Cs 280 & 291. | | Date and place where arrest took place. | 4.15 p.m. 31-8-32 at No 133 S Eu Lee (西屋里) off Alcock Road. | | Crime Register No. of offence for which arrested. (If an arrest for outside authorities details of offence for which arrested). | At 4 p.m. 31-8-32 D.P.S. Pitts and C.D.C. 280, attached to S.B., came to this Station accompanied by a representative of S.P.S.B. and stated that they were in possession of S.S.D.C. Warrants Nos 5087 & 5088 issued at the instigation of S.P.S.B. for the arrest of the abovenamed accused and for searching his house at the above address. The accused being wanted on a charge of being a communist. The assistance was rendered by D.P.S. Fawke & C.D.C. 291 and the accused was arrested at the time and place stated.
The search of his house failed to locate any literature, pamphlets, documents etc.
Questioned at this Station the accused denied being a member of the Communist Party.
A written statement was taken from him.
The accused will be brought before the S.S.D.C. on 1-9-32 when the representative of the S.P.S.B. will apply for his handing over. | | Name of investigating officer. | D.S. Utkin & C.D.C. 291. | | Initials of Senior Detective. | (Signature) J.R. 1/9. | This report is to be forwarded to Headquarters on the morning after arrest. It will be returned for particulars on back to be completed. In case of arrests for outside authorities, no Crime Register Number to be shown. (OVER)

D.2 E. Sba-1-31 送特别处主任副本 上海公共租界工部局警务处。 逮捕报告。 犯罪登记号：协助中国当局 “D”分区。 路边巡捕房。 （每名被捕者填写一份表格） 1932年8月31日。 | 被捕者姓名、年龄、职业及住址。 | Wong Sian Ding（王少亭），别名 Zoh Wei（周瑋），32岁，四川人，无业，住130号 | | :--- | :--- | | 逮捕人 | 侦探警司 Pitts 和 Fawke，以及华籍侦探警员 280号和 291号。 | | 逮捕日期及地点。 | 1932年8月31日下午4时15分，于阿尔科克路（Alcock Road）旁西屋里（S Eu Lee）133号。 | | 被捕罪行之犯罪登记号。（若为外部当局实施逮捕，需详述被捕罪名）。 | 1932年8月31日下午4时，隶属于特别处的侦探警司 Pitts 和华籍侦探警员 280号，在上海市公安局代表陪同下抵达本巡捕房，称其持有上海特区法院签发的第5087号和5088号搜查令，系应上海市公安局请求签发，用于逮捕上述被告并搜查其位于上述地址的住所。被告因涉嫌共产主义分子而被通缉。侦探警司 Fawke 和华籍侦探警员 291号提供了协助，被告于上述时间和地点被捕。
对其住所的搜查未发现任何书刊、小册子、文件等。
在本巡捕房受讯时，被告否认其为共产党成员。
已取其书面供词。
被告将于1932年9月1日被提解至上海特区法院，届时上海市公安局代表将申请将其引渡。 | | 调查警官姓名。 | 侦探警佐 Utkin 及华籍侦探警员 291号。 | | 高级侦探警佐首字母缩写。 | （签名）J.R. 9月1日。 | 本报告须于逮捕次日早晨呈送总部。 报告将退回以补全背面详情。 若是为外部当局实施逮捕，不得填写犯罪登记号。 （续下页）

Form 40
9017m 1-21.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
=========================
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
=========================

The following is the statement of Wong Siau Ling
native of Szechuen taken by me □□□ □□□
translated
at Wayside Str. on the 31st. Aug. 193□ and interpreted by Clark □□□ Sih

（批：List attached）

My name is Wong Siau Ling alias Koh ei, age 32 years,
native of Szechuen, unemployed. Formerly I was living at 'An
La Mei, Nan Lu Chung, Sui Ling Hsien, Szechuen. I arrived at
Shanghai on the 25th of July this year and reside at 138 Hou
Lee alleyway off Alcock Road. I have been graduated from Foong
Tu Hsien Primary School. I have been a food shop keeper at
Szechuen. I have no connection with any party. The searched
papers were placed at my home by one of my native friend named
Tsang Nyoch Dzung five days ago. I have never read those papers
and so I dont know what they are. This is my true statement.

(Signed) Wong Siau Ling.
pages.zh:
表格 40
9017m 1-21.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
=========================
警方调查报告。
=========================

以下为本人于193□年8月31日在路边街（Wayside Str.）取得的四川籍人士 Wong Siau Ling 之供词，由 Clark □□□ Sih 翻译。

（批注：附清单）

本人名为 Wong Siau Ling，别名 Koh ei，年龄32岁，
四川籍，无业。此前我居住在四川省绥陵县南路中安拉美（'An La Mei, Nan Lu Chung, Sui Ling Hsien, Szechuen）。我于今年7月25日抵达
上海，现居住于阿尔科克路（Alcock Road）旁后里（Hou Lee）弄堂138号。我毕业于丰都县（Foong Tu Hsien）小学。我曾在四川经营食品店。我与任何政党均无关联。被搜查的文件是五天前由我的一位同乡朋友 Tsang Nyoch Dzung（音译）放置在我家中的。我从未阅读过这些文件，因此不知其内容为何。此乃我的真实供词。

（签名）Wong Siau Ling。

List of literature seized at 133 S Eu Li, Alcock Road
on August 31,1932, on the authority of warrants issued
by the Shanghai Special District Court at the request
of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
-----

1) Draft of miscellaneous domestic accounts. 1 sheet.

2) Draft of petty accounts showing a balance
sheet of $53. (to Headquarters c/o
Honan Provincial Committee) 1 sheet.

3) Magazine entitled "New Creation" containing 1 copy.
articles on the 2nd world war, the 5-year
policy of Soviet Russia, etc.

4) Magazine entitled "Society and Education" 1 copy.
containing articles on the Lausanne
Conference, modern livelihood, etc.
pages.zh:
1932年8月31日，依据上海特区法院应上海市公安局请求签发的搜查令，在阿尔科克路（Alcock Road）西屋里（S Eu Li）133号查获的书刊清单。
-----

1) 杂项家庭账目草稿。1张。

2) 显示余额为53元的小额账目草稿。（致总部，转河南省委员会）1张。

3) 题为《新创造》（New Creation）的杂志。1本。
包含关于第二次世界大战、苏联五年计划等文章。

4) 题为《社会与教育》（Society and Education）的杂志。1本。
包含关于洛桑会议、现代生计等文章。
